size_basis: reactor-class study minimum (AQS-DUTY-073; envelope state standby - the recipe waits on the digester organic assay, AQS-DES-POLY)
solids_note: the skid chain (plinth, stand, kettle, jacket envelope, agitator, drive envelope, drain and vent) fuses to one solid; the inlet face stub stays separate until the connecting line makes its joint

kettle.wall_basis: study fab-page value (6 mm); the node books no thickness (WORK_ORDER W12)

jacket.basis: the node jacket_C 160 row; the jacket geometry is the envelope annulus (layout choice, WORK_ORDER W12)

internals.basis: shaft and two-blade impeller drawn as solids into the purchased drive envelope (plan rule 6); node internals row none, so the tracker records no internal solid

a_ves.basis: reported for the record: the duty claims no holdup (DIGEST_TO_POLY stays 0 until the digester organic assay issues the recipe); no residence time is derived (A-VES)

standby.basis: duty section 1 flows are 0; the model covers the installed geometry the node issues

material.basis: duty section 3: 316L, Hastelloy option; 316L drawn, the Hastelloy alternative is a named hold (WORK_ORDER W12); CA 0 mm (AQS-STD-001 rule)

a_mach_named.purchased: agitator drive 0.18 kW (node design row) drawn as its envelope and interface, plan rule 6; the rating reads the maker sheet at order

N1.note: schedule datum drawn as issued; open-bore tube flush at the envelope face (duty section 4: atmospheric joints are hose; the connecting line makes the joint at the face)

N2.note: drain boss under the base head, flush at the envelope bottom (schedule datum 50)

N3.note: vent riser on the top head, flush at the envelope top; the schedule datum 800 is the placeholder (hold, WORK_ORDER W12)

nozzle_idiom: atmospheric open-bore tube connections flush at the envelope faces (duty section 4: atmospheric joints are hose; the W4 110 percent rule draws no flange where no process pressure is stated); the schedule rating column (Class 150) is carried verbatim as text; datums draw as issued
